title: non slip tray
text: non slip tray. Set of 3 trays. They are white with little dots of silicone to create the non slip surface. They are graduated in size, two have handles at the ends, the smallest tray does not have handle, but is lipped.  All of the trays have lipped, curved edges.  I like them.  What you put on them will not slip around!  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Bravi Kitchen 3PC Anti-Slip Food Serving Tray with Handles 17.9" + 15.7" + 13" Dinner Trays for Lap + Small Drink Tray | Breakfast Tray | Bed Tray | Food Tray | Lap Trays for Eating | Serving Trays
features: Anti-Slip Technology: Perfect for indoor or outdoor dining, this rectangular non-slip serving tray features an anti-slip patterned surface so your dishes and drinks won’t slip or tip over. Serve up snacks nicely and steady.
3 Unique sizes in a bundle: Comes in large (17.9 in), medium (15.7 in), and small (13.3 inches in). 3 different sizes to complement your serving style for all occasions, big or small.
Easy to carry: Easy-grip handles make it super easy to haul around drinks or food with confidence since there is no chance that your dish or drinks will fall or slip off.
Easy to clean: Wood trays that may absorb water and take time to dry, our serving tray is super easy to clean and dry.
BPA free, shatterproof, and dishwasher safe: Proudly made of sturdy, BPA-free plastic, this non-slip tray is lightweight, shatter and heat resistant.
